jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Guardian is seeking a Data Engineer to join the team responsible for establishing and maintaining an optimized, scalable data pipelines to provide access to high quality, consistent data in an easy and convenient manner to all authorized end users and applications of Guardian and its subsidiaries.  
  
As a Data Engineer, you will play a vital role in our data infrastructure and analytics ecosystem. You will work closely with data architects and data scientists to build and maintain data pipelines, transform raw data into actionable insights, and contribute to the development of cutting-edge data solutions. This is an excellent hands-on opportunity to experience the latest technologies and make a significant impact on our data-driven initiatives. The position will integrate new data sources from enterprise sources and external vendors using a variety of ingestion patterns including Structured Query Language (SQL) Ingestion, File, and Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).

You will

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and translate them into effective data pipelines.
* Design and maintain reliable batch and real-time ingestion pipelines for databases, files, APIs, event streams, and third-party data sources, including schema evolution, error handling, and data quality controls.
* Develop and operationalize scalable data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and SQL to transform ingested data into curated, trusted, and business-ready data assets.
* Leverage Databricks to build, orchestrate, optimize, and govern production-grade data pipelines and data assets.
* Build governed, high-quality data assets that support analytics, machine learning, and generative AI use cases.
* Design scalable dimensional and domain-oriented data models, define schemas and data contracts, and optimize data structures for performance and usability.
* Implement observability, automated data-quality checks, and proactive alerting to ensure pipeline reliability, performance, and compliance with service-level objectives.
* Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation efforts to maintain high-quality code and data documentation.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in data engineering.
* Continue to look for innovative and next generation solutions for solving data challenges.

You are

A self-starter, self-motivated team player and have excellent communication skills, enabling you to engage with all levels of stakeholders who is fueled by collaboration, able to transform conceptual designs into reliable, scalable processes that meet or exceed customer needs. An individual who works closely with IT and business leaders across the enterprise to drive and embed the Enterprise Data Strategy into transformational roadmaps ensuring key principles of Data Governance, Data Management, Data Analytics and Architecture are implemented.  
  
You have

  

* 10+ Years of IT experience, with 5+ years of experience as a Data Architect, data engineer or other data professional
* Expert knowledge of relational and NoSQL database concepts, with hands-on experience across PostgreSQL, Oracle, Databricks, and cloud-native data stores.
* Expert proficiency in logical, physical, dimensional, and domain-oriented data modeling, including schema design and data contracts; experience with enterprise modeling tools is preferred.
* Extensive hands-on data engineering experience with distributed data processing and lakehouse technologies, including Python and PySpark on the Databricks platform.
* Hands-on experience designing and optimizing large-scale data pipelines and data-warehouse architecture using batch and incremental processing, change data capture, orchestration, and schema evolution.
* Experience with AWS data services and modern cloud data platforms, including Amazon S3, PostgreSQL, and Databricks.
* Demonstrated expertise with data sourcing, profiling, data mapping and data analysis.
* Expert SQL skills, including complex query development, performance optimization, data transformations, and scalable data-structure design.
* Ability to design secure, scalable cloud-native data solutions across object storage, lakehouse platforms, SaaS integrations, relational databases, and NoSQL data stores.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and creative problem-solving skills.
* Ability to adapt to changing business priorities and experience effectively communicating changes across different levels in the organization.
* Communication Skills: Articulate the vision and goals, both to the team members and other stakeholders.
* Emotional Intelligence & Empathy: Motivate, inspire, and resolve conflicts with others while building a positive rapport with team members and partners.
* Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with the Product Manager and your leadership and keep appraised with key updates and planning. Encourage partnership between team members to create a more dynamic and effective work environment.
* Strong listeners and able to provide constructive feedback.
* SAFE experience and the ability to work on a cross functional, self-organizing development teams is a plus.

* Significant experience interfacing with both customers and management across business and IT
* Reltio proficiency and Agentic AI development with Bedrock

Location

  

* New York NY, Holmdel NJ or Bethlehem PA .
* Up to 10% travel within the NY/NJ/PA locations

**Salary Range:**

$99,150.00 - $162,885.00

The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. In addition to salary, this role may also be eligible for annual, sales, or other incentive compensation.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Philadelphia
jobs.description:
The Data Engineer will join the Enterprise Data & Analytics team to design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and integrations that support reporting, analytics, and business operations. Alongside hands-on engineering, this role will help strengthen the firm’s data management and governance practices through improved data quality, clear documentation, and consistent standards.

Working with colleagues across IT and business teams, you’ll translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and help ensure data is accurate, accessible, and well-managed. You’ll support the existing data environment while contributing to efforts to modernize integrations, evaluate new technologies, and improve how data is delivered across the firm.

**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:**

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and integrations using SQL, SSIS, Python, and Boomi as appropriate, connecting databases, applications, APIs, and file-based sources.
* Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and warehouse data structures to deliver consistent, well-documented datasets for reporting and analytics.
* Develop and maintain Azure DevOps build and release pipelines to deploy, schedule, and monitor Python-based data processes and automation.
* Build and maintain a reusable data quality framework, including data profiling, automated validation rules, reconciliation, monitoring, alerts, and quality metrics.
* Partner with business data owners and stewards to define quality rules and thresholds, investigate root causes, and track data issues through remediation.
* Support data governance initiatives by documenting metadata, lineage, source-to-target mappings, and critical data elements, and implementing standards and controls agreed with business owners.
* Contribute to the SSIS-to-Boomi migration, including inventorying existing processes and dependencies, documenting transformation logic, rebuilding integrations, testing and reconciling results, and supporting production cutover.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production pipelines, improving performance and reliability through logging, error handling, alerting, and recovery procedures.
* Support data platform evaluation and potential migration activities, including assessing existing workloads, adapting pipelines, validating data, and maintaining continuity for downstream users.
* Maintain technical documentation, testing procedures, and operational runbooks; communicate progress, dependencies, and issues clearly to technical and business stakeholders.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Strong proficiency in SQL and SQL Server, including complex joins, stored procedures, indexing, and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience developing and supporting production SSIS packages, ETL processes, and data integrations.
* Practical experience implementing data profiling, quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and issue resolution
* Understanding of data management and governance concepts, including metadata, lineage, data ownership, stewardship, and critical data elements.
* Hands-on Boomi integration development experience is preferred; experience migrating SSIS or other legacy integration processes to Boomi is a plus.
* Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake experience is a plus, including familiarity with data ingestion, pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse workloads, and notebooks.
* Working knowledge of Python for data processing, validation, and automation.
* Familiarity with API and file-based integrations, version control, testing, and controlled deployment practices; experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and releases is preferred.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and troubleshooting skills, with attention to data accuracy, production reliability, and documentation.
* Ability to work collaboratively, manage competing priorities, learn new technologies, and explain technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data integration, or data management roles.
* Experience supporting integration modernization or data platform migrations is a plus.
* Understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including star and snowflake schemas.
* Experience in a law firm, professional services organization, or with financial systems is a plus.

jobs.title: Staff, Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Enterprise AI (EAI) builds the data foundations that GSK's AI systems depend on. In our operating model, digital workers do the hands-on data engineering. They generate pipelines, test and deploy them, monitor them in production and remediate failures. Our engineers design the system those digital workers operate in.

At the centre of that system is a governed context layer. It makes data, meaning, permissions and history retrievable at the moment they are needed, and sits above our data platforms and beneath every experience and agent built on them.

The Staff Data Engineer is accountable for implementing and evolving the governed context layer that humans and digital workers use across EAI, and is EAI's internal authority on data architecture for AI.

* **Owns the governed context layer** as the shared foundation every human and digital worker in EAI relies on, accountable for its architecture, implementation and evolution.
* **Defines the system digital workers engineer within** through the standards, frameworks, contracts and guardrails that let them build and operate pipelines safely, consistently and at scale.
* **Raises the standard of data engineering for AI** across EAI through the architecture, governance and engineering practices others adopt, and through the senior engineers the role develops.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Context & Semantics

* **Implement and evolve the governed context layer** as a product: one layer across enterprise knowledge, structured data, business vocabulary and modelled ontologies, queried by humans and digital workers at run time.
* **Build the capabilities the layer depends on:** reliable cataloguing across structured and unstructured data, AI-assisted metadata enrichment, context design for each use case, secure agent access over standard protocols such as MCP, and routing across sources.
* **Make certified meaning machine-readable** so that every number a digital worker returns resolves to one governed definition, with clear ownership and lineage.

Agent-Operated Data Engineering

* **Define the architecture standards and shared frameworks** that digital workers use to generate, test, deploy and monitor pipelines, reducing the integration cost of each new AI initiative.
* **Set the operating model for agent-generated engineering work:** what digital workers do autonomously, what requires human approval, how quality is evaluated and how incidents escalate. Lead the incidents digital workers cannot resolve, from detection to permanent resolution.

AI Data Infrastructure & Lifecycle

* **Shape EAI's AI data infrastructure strategy** across feature engineering, vector and retrieval infrastructure, streaming data flows and evaluation data design, building shared components that multiple AI initiatives depend on in production.
* **Define EAI's MLOps data practices:** versioning, lineage, drift monitoring, evaluation dataset governance and model data lifecycle management, extended to the context and evaluation data that digital workers rely on.

Governance & Responsible Data

* **Define EAI's responsible data governance standards for AI pipelines,** covering privacy, consent, PII, auditability and bias controls, and encode them in the governed context layer so humans and digital workers apply them by default.
* **Shape data quality and lineage at scale** across multiple data domains, with measurable outcomes in error rates, downstream AI performance and audit readiness.

Platform & Infrastructure

* **Design EAI's data platform architecture** with infrastructure as code throughout and platform-as-product thinking, so new data and AI projects start quickly and consistently.
* **Build shared platform components** that AI initiatives, engineering teams and digital workers depend on in production, and own their reliability, performance, cost and security.

Standards & Technical Leadership

* **Define data engineering standards** for code, documentation and review, written to be followed by humans and digital workers alike, and drive their adoption across EAI.
* **Develop senior engineers** towards greater architectural independence, and partner with forward deployed engineers (FDEs), ML engineers, platform engineers and domain experts on the data requirements of production AI systems.

**Why You?**
  
**Basic Qualification**  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of data engineering experience, including experience defining data architecture for production AI or machine learning (ML) systems.
* Experience building data infrastructure for AI systems, including feature stores, vector databases, retrieval architectures, streaming data pipelines and evaluation datasets.
* Experience building context, metadata or semantic infrastructure used by AI systems, such as data catalogues, business glossaries, knowledge graphs or ontologies, exposed to AI agents through protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience designing and operating AI agents or large language model (LLM)-powered systems within data workflows, including evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Experience defining data quality, lineage and governance standards for AI pipelines across multiple data domains, including privacy, consent, personally identifiable information (PII) handling and auditability.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and infrastructure as code, including experience setting engineering standards.

**Preferred Qualification**  
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

* Prior Staff, Principal or equivalent experience in an organisation operating a non-trivial data platform for AI.
* Experience in a regulated industry, such as life sciences, where data integrity and auditability are mandatory.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. ---------------------

The Lead Business Systems Analyst is the functional domain lead for client Integrated Workplace Management System (IWMS) implementations on IBM TRIRIGA and Maximo, including Maximo Application Suite (MAS) and Maximo Real Estate and Facilities (MREF). This role is the functional authority on how the platforms should solve a client's real estate and facilities challenges: it sets the solution direction, makes and owns functional design decisions, and directs the business analysts who carry out detailed requirements and testing work. The Lead Business Systems Analyst works directly with client domain leaders and with globally distributed onshore and offshore delivery teams, and is accountable for the quality of all functional deliverables on assigned engagements.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The **IT Systems Analyst** maintains, troubleshoots and repairs computer hardware, software, network, and minor server problems. In addition the incumbent installs new hardware, performs software upgrades, and provides desktop administration as required. Assigned area(s) of responsibility are activities of moderate complexity and impact. In addition, the individual will handle the administration and acquisition of mobile devices and serve as the primary support administrator for smartphone, tablets, and non-windows devices as require for the support of the organization. In this role they will provide technical advice and support to system users. This individual is expected to perform a variety of tasks as required for business operational support. The incumbent must consistently demonstrate the ability to work both independently and in a team setting, demonstrating flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced business environment.

This is a **remote position for candidates residing in Florida State.** It may require periodic travel to branch locations within the assigned geographic area.

**Duties include but are not limited to:**

* Actively coordinates with team members and other service support groups to effectively resolve incidents and requests.
* Provides tier 2 technical support and service restoration for daily operations and project efforts.
* + Follows procedures and guidelines to install, configure, customize, troubleshoot, upgrade, integrate, and maintain systems, software, workstations, printers, wireless devices, and handheld devices.
* Deploying and reporting updates with Systems Management Server or System Center
* Configuration Manager or similar enterprise management tools for desktop management
* Creating discrete software images for deployment of end client devices or providing recovery solutions for client devices.
* Supports and collaborates with team members and other technical staff.
* Demonstrates quality service and accountability in the process of: resolving incidents; and, tracking computer systems and device inventory, resulting in accurate, timely, and efficient solutions and data as evidenced by: meeting customer needs; meeting or exceeding established performance metrics; and accurate data for asset management, billing, and licensing.
* Proactively seeks information and utilizes analytical and creative problem-solving skills along with standard processes and technologies resulting in secure and reliable connections to and use of systems, applications, and infrastructure.
* Demonstrates relationship building, effective communication skills, and quality service in the process of collaborating with, supporting, advising, and educating customers and team members on the use of services, handling of sensitive data, and resolving incidents, resulting in efficient, effective, and compliant use of hardware, software and services.
* Promotes understanding with customers on the benefits of the IT service provider model to help foster collaboration.
* Contributes to hardware, software, services enhancements by identifying when established procedures are not working and there are gaps in processes and makes recommendations for improvements. Develops and edits customer and technical support knowledge base documentation.
* Demonstrates relationship building and effective communication skills as a member of technical services through active listening and frequent communication with department staff, resulting in understanding customer needs, creating buy-in for enhancements, and collaboration with department staff.
* Demonstrates quality service by actively contributing to customer satisfaction through advocating for customer needs, escalating incidents and requests, and increasing the customer’s ability to help themselves, resulting in meeting or exceeding customer satisfaction metrics.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Maintain, troubleshoot and repair computer hardware, software, network, and minor server
* problems configurations.
* Knowledge of Windows 10 and 11
* Knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory usage.
* Knowledge of TCP/IP Networking Protocols.
* Professional communication skills (phone, interpersonal, written, verbal, etc.).
* Project management at a proficient level.
* Self-motivated, proactive, detail oriented and a team player.
* Time management and time critical prioritization skills.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelors Degree Required

* Technical Certifications

**Travel Requirements**

jobs.title: Snowflake/ Databricks Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Snowflake Data Engineer to join our innovative team.

**Snowflake/ Databricks Data Engineer | About You**

As a Snowflake/ Databricks Data Engineer, you are responsible for transforming raw data into trusted, authoritative sources that drive business decisions. You thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment and enjoy solving complex data integration challenges. You're passionate about data commercialization, AI-driven insights, and enabling self-service analytics across the organization. Your ability to collaborate across teams and leverage modern cloud technologies like Azure and Snowflake makes you a key player in our data strategy.

**Snowflake/ Databricks Data Engineer | Day-to-Day**

* Design and maintain scalable data pipelines using Snowflake or Databricks, Azure, and Azure Service Bus to support enterprise-wide initiatives.
* Lead data integration efforts, extracting data from external sources and landing it in Snowflake, including data modeling and transformation.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to develop authoritative data sources that support data commercialization and strategic decision-making.
* Use Agile tools like Jira, ServiceNow, and Azure DevOps for sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily stand-ups.
* Support modernization efforts by transitioning from legacy tools (e.g., SnowMirror) to cloud-native solutions.
* Enable self-service analytics through platforms like Power BI and Sigma, ensuring data integrity and accessibility.

**Snowflake/ Databricks Data Engineer | Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a related technical field.
* Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, and Azure Service Bus in enterprise environments.
* Proven ability in data modeling, pipeline development, and scalable data architecture.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, and Azure DevOps.
* Working knowledge of Power BI, Sigma, and principles of self-service analytics.
* Exposure to Python and interest in collaborating on automation, scripting, and AI-driven data initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer – Technical Interviewer
jobs.description:
Senior Data Engineer – Technical Interviewer (Part-Time Contract)

**Location:** Remote – United States or Canada  
**Job Type:** Part-Time Contract / Independent Contractor  
**Hours:** 5–20 hours per week, depending on availability and business needs  
**Compensation:** Contract-based compensation, discussed with qualified candidates

About the Opportunity

We are building a technology-focused talent assessment network that connects experienced engineering professionals with technical evaluation opportunities.

Our approach emphasizes practical engineering expertise, structured assessments, and meaningful feedback to help organizations evaluate technical talent. We collaborate with technology professionals and recruitment partners to support the technical evaluation and hiring process.

We are expanding our network of experienced engineers who can contribute their expertise on a flexible, part-time basis.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to conduct technical interviews and evaluate the skills of data engineering candidates.

This is a remote, part-time contract opportunity suited to experienced professionals with strong hands-on data engineering backgrounds, excellent communication skills, and the ability to assess technical knowledge objectively.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct live technical interviews for mid-to-senior-level data engineering candidates.
* Evaluate candidates' knowledge of data architecture, data modeling, distributed processing, and cloud-based data platforms.
* Assess proficiency in Python, SQL, and relevant data engineering technologies.
* Lead technical discussions covering data pipelines, system design, scalability, and performance optimization.
* Provide structured, objective feedback on candidates' technical strengths and areas for improvement.
* Coordinate with the operations team to facilitate interviews and technical assessments.
* Maintain consistency, professionalism, and fairness throughout the evaluation process.

Required Qualifications

* 8+ years of professional data engineering experience in corporate, enterprise, or established IT services environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, and modern data engineering technologies.
* Knowledge of distributed processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Flink, or Hadoop.
* Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Familiarity with modern data warehouses and lakehouse platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.
* Understanding of data modeling, data pipelines, streaming technologies, and production data systems.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to provide clear, structured, and objective technical assessments.
* Legal authorization to work in the United States or Canada, as applicable to the engagement.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience conducting technical interviews or evaluating engineering candidates.
* Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing technical designs, or participating in engineering hiring decisions.
* Knowledge of structured technical interviewing and competency-based assessment methods.
* A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Work Arrangement

* Fully remote, part-time contract engagement.
* Flexible scheduling based on mutual availability and interview demand.
* An expected commitment of approximately 5–20 hours per week, depending on business requirements and your availability.
* Ongoing collaboration opportunities based on performance, availability, and business needs.

Pay: $55.00 - $70.00 per hour

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Junior Data Engineer**

**Technology & Innovation Team**

**Location:** Irwindale, CA (100% Remote Work Opportunity)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | Non-Exempt

### **Turn Data Into Possibilities. Build What's Next at Rize!**

Are you passionate about data, technology, and solving problems? Do you enjoy finding ways to turn complex information into meaningful insights? If you're looking to grow your career in data engineering while making a real impact, we want to meet you!

At **Rize Credit Union**, we're growing our Technology & Innovation team and looking for a curious, detail-oriented **Junior Data Engineer** to help us build smarter, more efficient ways to use data across our organization.

In this role, you'll help develop and maintain data pipelines, improve data quality, and create reporting solutions that empower our teams to make informed decisions. You'll collaborate with business and technology partners, explore opportunities for automation, and contribute to innovative solutions that support our mission of ending poverty through financial empowerment.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Build & Optimize Data Pipelines:** Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining ETL processes that transform data from multiple sources into reliable, accessible information.
* **Develop Data Solutions:** Write and optimize SQL queries, support data modeling, and help maintain efficient data infrastructure and data warehouses.
* **Ensure Data Quality:** Monitor data accuracy, troubleshoot pipeline issues, and help maintain the integrity and reliability of information used throughout the organization.
* **Create Meaningful Insights:** Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, SSRS, or Amazon QuickSight to help teams understand and act on data.
* **Drive Innovation & Efficiency:** Identify opportunities to automate workflows, improve processes, and enhance how we collect, manage, and use data.
* **Collaborate Across Teams:** Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, translate requirements into practical data solutions, and support data-driven decision-making.
* **Share Knowledge:** Document solutions, support end users, and help team members make the most of our reporting and analytics tools.

### **What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who's technically capable, naturally curious, eager to learn, and excited about using data to solve real business challenges.

**Your Background & Technical Skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or database engineering.
* Strong SQL skills, including query optimization, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
* Experience developing and maintaining ETL pipelines and working with data warehouses.
* Proficiency with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, SSRS, or Amazon QuickSight.
* Familiarity with data lakes, cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), and data governance practices.
* Experience in financial services is strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with Python or R is a plus!

**What Will Help You Succeed:**

* You're a **problem-solver** who enjoys digging into data, identifying patterns, and finding better ways to get things done.
* You're **curious and eager to learn**, staying interested in emerging technologies and new approaches to data engineering.
* You have **strong attention to detail** and take pride in producing accurate, reliable work.
* You're a **collaborative communicator** who can explain technical concepts and data insights to non-technical audiences.
* You're **self-motivated and adaptable**, comfortable managing competing priorities and working independently in a remote environment.
* You bring **fresh ideas and an innovative mindset**, always looking for opportunities to improve processes and create value.

### **Why Join Rize?**

At Rize Credit Union, we're more than a financial institution. We're a team of people committed to making a difference through **knowledge, access, and care**.

Our Technology & Innovation team plays an important role in helping us work smarter, improve the member experience, and create meaningful change.

As a Junior Data Engineer, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, collaborate with experienced professionals, expand your technical expertise, and help shape how we leverage data for the future.

**If you're ready to grow your career, embrace new challenges, and help us go Beyond Banking, we'd love to hear from you!**

### **Work Arrangement**

This position is based out of our corporate headquarters in Irwindale, California, with the flexibility to work **100% remotely**.

### **Compensation**

**Hourly Pay Range:** $40.00 - $53.00

This is a non-exempt position eligible for overtime compensation in accordance with applicable laws. Actual compensation is determined by experience, education, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.

As part of the hiring process, candidates who receive a contingent offer will undergo a background investigation, which may include employment verification, credit review, criminal records search, Social Security verification, and government registry checks. Candidates must also meet eligibility requirements to be bonded under a fidelity bond.

### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Rize Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants. We value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives and provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process.

**About iCOUNTER**

iCOUNTER is redefining how enterprises defend against cyber threats originating across their extended business ecosystems.
  
  
Our AI-native Counter Threat Operating System (CTOS) combines threat intelligence, risk determination, and operational response to help organizations identify and act on threats involving third parties, subsidiaries, portfolio companies, and interconnected business relationships.
  
  
We believe enterprises need to move beyond traditional risk assessments and static security scores toward intelligence-led, proactive defense.
  
  
We’re building a new category of cybersecurity, and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us bring it to market.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer / Data Engineer** to join our Threat Intelligence Collections team. You will design, build, and operate large-scale data collection systems that gather, enrich, and deliver high-fidelity threat intelligence from the open web, deep web, and dark web sources. This is a high-impact, technically challenging role at the intersection of cybersecurity, data engineering, and modern AI-driven automation.

You will own the full lifecycle of threat data pipelines — from raw source ingestion to clean, structured, and queryable intelligence that powers our detection, hunting, and response capabilities.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Design and scale high-volume data collection systems that ingest threat data from open-web, deep-web, and dark-web sources (including Tor, I2P, and other anonymity networks).
* Build and maintain robust, fault-tolerant data pipelines (batch + streaming) for ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and storage.
* Develop advanced data parsing and normalization logic for unstructured, semi-structured, and rapidly evolving threat data formats
* Design, build, and maintain agentic workflows — autonomous, LLM-powered agents that can reason, adapt, and execute multi-step collection and enrichment tasks.
* Architect and operate high-scale media pipelines for ingesting, processing, storing, and enriching large volumes of media content (images, videos, screenshots, documents, etc.) collected from threat intelligence sources.
* Design and build internal and external APIs that expose collected intelligence to downstream security teams and platforms.
* Write clean, production-grade Python code as the primary language for all data engineering and automation work.
* Collaborate closely with threat intelligence analysts, detection engineers, and security researchers to translate intel requirements into reliable, scalable data systems.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously optimize collection performance, data quality, and latency at scale.
* Stay current with emerging threat actor TTPs, data sources, and evasion techniques to proactively improve collection coverage.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED**

* 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer or Data Engineer, with a strong focus on large-scale data collection and processing.
* **Deep experience collecting data at scale** from open and dark web sources (scraping, crawling, API integration, Tor-based collection, anti-detection/anti-bot techniques).
* Strong expertise in building and operating **data pipelines** (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Flink, or equivalent).
* Advanced **data parsing** skills — experience turning messy, unstructured web data into clean, structured intelligence.
* **Expert-level Python** proficiency (including async, concurrency, and performance optimization).
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing **agentic workflows** (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks) and integrating LLMs into production data systems.
* Track record of **building and maintaining production APIs** (FastAPI, Flask, or similar).
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts and threat intelligence data types (IOCs, TTPs, malware samples, phishing kits, underground forums, etc.).
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with high-stakes data quality requirements.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Experience with cloud platforms.
* Knowledge of modern data stack tools (dbt, Snowflake, ClickHouse, DuckDB, etc.).
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code.
* Prior work in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or intelligence collection organizations.
* Contributions to open-source tools or public research in the threat intel or data collection space.

* 401(k), HSA, & FSA Plans
* Flexible PTO
* Meaningful equity ownership

Join our dynamic team as a Data Engineer and become a vital driver of our data-driven decision-making process! In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines and architectures that empower our organization to harness the full potential of big data. You’ll work with cutting-edge technologies and collaborate across teams to deliver scalable, efficient, and innovative data solutions. Your expertise will enable us to turn complex data into actionable insights, fueling strategic growth and operational excellence.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and optimize ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure seamless data flow across various platforms using tools like Talend, Informatica, and Shell Scripting.
* Design and maintain scalable data warehouses and data lakes utilizing AWS, Azure Data Lake, Hadoop, Apache Hive, Spark, and related big data technologies.
* Build and manage databases with Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, and other relational systems; ensure high performance and security standards.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, analyze data needs, and translate them into technical solutions using SQL, Python, Java, and Bash scripting.
* Integrate linked data sources through RESTful APIs for comprehensive analytics capabilities.
* Support model training initiatives by preparing large datasets for machine learning applications.
* Conduct analysis to identify trends or issues within datasets; communicate findings effectively using Looker or other visualization tools.
* Maintain documentation of data architecture designs, workflows, and procedures following Agile methodologies for continuous improvement.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in designing and implementing large-scale data pipelines using AWS services such as S3, Glue, or Redshift.
* Strong proficiency in programming languages including Java and Python for data processing tasks.
* Extensive knowledge of big data frameworks like Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, Hive) and Spark for distributed processing.
* Hands-on experience with SQL Server, Oracle databases, and Data Warehouse concepts to support enterprise analytics initiatives.
* Familiarity with ETL tools such as Talend or Informatica for efficient data integration workflows.
* Experience working with cloud platforms like Azure Data Lake or similar environments is highly desirable.
* Solid understanding of database design principles combined with analysis skills to interpret complex datasets effectively.
* Knowledge of shell scripting (Bash), Unix/Linux environments, RESTful API integration, and VBA is a plus. Join us if you’re passionate about transforming raw data into powerful insights! We’re committed to fostering an innovative environment where your technical expertise makes a real impact on our organization’s success.

Pay: $118,783.29 - $143,050.84 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.description:
**About the Organization**

Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

**About the Role**

Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking a Senior Data Engineer / Lead to join our team supporting the US National Defense Strategy. In this role, you will play a vital role in translating complex defense requirements into scalable data pipelines and actionable insights, directly contributing to the modernization of critical defense systems.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Leadership & Task Oversight:** Provide day-to-day task prioritization and technical direction to team members; lead code reviews, ensure design best practices, and mentor engineers in modular Python development and SQL optimization.
* **Requirements Development & Architecture**: Work directly with government stakeholders to elicit, refine, and translate complex mission requirements into robust technical specifications, interface designs, and scalable data models.
* **Pipeline & Platform Development:** Architect, develop, and optimize high-throughput ETL/ELT workflows using Databricks; maintain, refactor, and enhance existing Python and SQL codebases for performance, stability, and security.
* **Pipeline Diagnostics & Troubleshooting:** Identify pipeline bottlenecks, debug complex data workflows, and implement automated solutions to enhance pipeline reliability and data integrity.
* **C****ross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner closely with government product owners, data scientists, Data Analysts, and technical peers to document architecture, coordinate technical sprints, and communicate engineering trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Technical Documentation:** Develop new and maintain existing pipeline architecture documentation relating to pipeline code architecture and configurations to ensure high system reliability and seamless team onboarding.

### **Required Experience/Clearance**

* **Security Clearance:** Must be a U.S. Citizen with a current, active U.S. Government Secret clearance. (Applicants without an active Secret clearance cannot be considered).
* **Experience Level:** Minimum of 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, building enterprise-scale data platforms and pipelines.
* **Technical Guidance:** Demonstrated experience providing technical mentorship, performing code reviews, and providing day-to-day technical task oversight to other engineers.
* **Databricks:** Proven, hands-on experience designing and optimizing data transformation workflows in Databricks.
* **Python/PySpark & SQL:** Advanced skills in modular, object-oriented Python/PySpark scripting and extensive experience writing, tuning, and optimizing complex SQL queries.
* **Data Visualization:** Proven experience building functional, user-centric reports and dashboards using modern data visualization tools.

### **Desired Experience**

We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:

* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed computing frameworks.
* Familiarity with modern agile and DevOps tools such as GitLab Jira.
* Experience working with DoD, defense, or intelligence community data environments and compliance standards.
* Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data cataloging frameworks.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.

Redhorse Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by contacting Talent Acquisition at Talent-Acquisition@redhorsecorp.com

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**What is Reach Financial?**

Reach Financial is a FinTech platform helping people outsmart debt for good.

We are building innovative products and best-in-class support that enable our customers to take control of their debt and de-mystify their personal finances. Our products and tools empower our customers to turn their financial goals into a reality.

Reach Financial launched in 2015 and has helped our customers pay off over $1 billion in debt. We offer debt consolidation loans and personal loans; together, these markets represent a $1.5T opportunity. In time, we will expand beyond these products to offer solutions for a variety of our customers' personal finance challenges.

We are a fast-growing and fast-paced FinTech startup with the stability of an established firm. You will have a front-row seat at a rapidly growing company innovating the FinTech industry.

**About the role**

As a Senior Data Engineer at Reach, you’ll work alongside our existing Data Engineering team on our data platform modernization effort. You’ll be a key contributor to our broader data practice, building and maintaining pipelines, data models, and transformations as we modernize Reach’s data stack. You’ll help establish scalable, reliable, and consistent data engineering practices across the organization, ushering in a new era of cohesive data design and management within the broader Engineering organization.

**What you'll do**

* Develop and manage data pipelines, data models, schemas, and data artifacts as a core contributor to our data squad.
* Champion data engineering best practices, including data quality, version control, testing, and documentation.
* Collaborate with Data, Software, and Platform Engineers to evolve and improve existing engineering practices, tools, and infrastructure.
* Partner with data scientists, analysts, stakeholders, and cross-functional data teams across the organization to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Stay up to date on emerging data engineering tools and technologies, and help evaluate new solutions to optimize our data ecosystem.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineers to ensure seamless integration and deployment of data pipelines using shared CI/CD tools and Infrastructure as Code solutions, such as GitHub Actions and Terraform.
* Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, proactively identifying and resolving issues to ensure data quality, reliability, and availability.
* Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines, data models, and engineering processes.

**What you should have**

* 6+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, working with dbt (Core or Cloud), Snowflake, Fivetran, Amazon RDS, PostgreSQL, etc
* Strong proficiency in dbt development best practices and coding conventions, with hands-on experience designing and implementing Medallion data architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) in a production environment.
* Extensive knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores
* Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar platforms
* Experience implementing automated data quality checks, dbt testing, and data validation frameworks
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, and automated deployment processes for data engineering workflows
* Demonstrated experience optimizing Snowflake performance, dbt models, SQL queries, and data warehouse costs
* Production experience working with and managing a Snowflake deployment
* Experience extracting information from SaaS systems like Salesforce using ETL tools like FiveTran
* Production experience using dbt Cloud or other source-driven transformation management tools
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Database Change Management tooling
* Experience with operational database management, including backup, recovery, tuning, data modeling, scaling
* Demonstrated experience with Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages
* Must be self-motivated, focused, and highly committed to delivering value
* Must be a collaborative team player with strong communication skills, a willingness to share knowledge, and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

**Nice to haves**

* Experience preparing data for analysis in Tableau or other BI tools
* Experience with Tableau CRM Analytics Data Pipelines
* Experience with Sigma Computing
* Experience with Fivetran Activations
* Experience working in the Financial Services industry and familiarity with working in a SOC2 and PCI-DSS environment.

**What is it like working at Reach Financial?**

Our culture is built around advancing our teams, and we are dedicated to the success and growth of every team member. We believe in retaining a high-performing workforce and we prioritize diversity, intellectual curiosity, and continued learning. Our generous benefits packages reflect that.

We’ve been hard at work perfecting our product for years, and now we’re growing faster than ever before. Our strong foundation and company culture is readily equipped for this growth, and we believe that with the right people, our products will continue to help customers make real changes in their financial lives.

**What benefits will you receive?**

* Healthcare, Life Insurance, 401k Match
* Paid Time Off, Paid 12-week Parental Leave
* Disability (short-term, long-term), Employee Assistance Program
* Spending Accounts (Transit/Parking, Medical, Dependent Care)
* Insurance Discounts (home, auto, pet)

 **The pay range for this role is:**  
150,000 - 200,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.description:
**About Coderio**

Coderio designs and delivers scalable digital solutions for global companies. With a solid technical foundation and a product-oriented mindset, our teams lead complex software projects—from architecture to execution. We value autonomy, clear communication, and technical excellence. We collaborate closely with international teams and partners, building technology that creates an impact.  
  
Learn more: http://coderio.com

### **Job Overview**

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer based in the US to design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines and scalable infrastructure across our cloud platform. In this role, you will play a key part in enabling Data Products throughout their lifecycle—sourcing data via batch and stream processing, optimizing data architecture, and ensuring data quality. You will collaborate closely with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to automate workflows and deploy resilient data pipelines in production.

* **Work Location / Employment:** US-based (Remote / Hybrid) — Must be authorized to work in the United States.

### **Tech Stack & Key Technologies**

* **Cloud Platforms:** AWS (Redshift, Glue, EMR, MWAA, S3) & GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Storage)
* **Languages & Frameworks:** Python, PySpark, SQL (advanced optimization & tuning)
* **Data Engineering & Ops:** Batch & Stream Processing, ETL/ELT Pipelines, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, Orchestration
* **DevOps, Infrastructure & Tools:** Docker, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, UNIX/Linux environments, MLOps best practices

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Pipeline Architecture & Development:** Design, build, and deploy scalable, decoupled, and high-performance data pipelines for batch and streaming data ingestion into Data Lakes and Data Warehouses.
* **ETL/ELT Processing:** Develop and optimize efficient data pipelines using Python, PySpark, and advanced SQL.
* **Collaboration with ML & Data Science:** Partner with Data Scientists and ML Engineers to build resilient pipelines, automate MLOps workflows, and gather model interaction data to support retraining loops.
* **Performance Optimization & Monitoring:** Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize pipeline execution, query performance, and storage resource utilization across cloud platforms.
* **Data Quality & Governance:** Implement data quality frameworks and testing controls to ensure data integrity, reliability, and governance across raw and curated datasets.
* **DevOps & Standards:** Apply MLOps and DevOps best practices, maintain CI/CD pipelines, use Docker for containerization, and document technical standards and architectures.

### **Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and running large-scale data systems.
* **Core Languages:** Mastery of Python and advanced SQL (query optimization and performance tuning).
* **Cloud & Big Data Tools:** Hands-on experience with AWS (Redshift, Glue, EMR, MWAA, S3) or GCP (BigQuery) and modern data processing engines (PySpark).
* **Engineering Ecosystem:** Proficiency with UNIX environments, Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
* **Data & ML Lifecycle:** Solid understanding of data structures, batch/streaming processing, and familiarity with MLOps or the ML deployment lifecycle.
* **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform).
* Experience building and maintaining scalable REST APIs.
* Exposure to prompt engineering workflows or generative AI data pipelines.

**Why join Coderio?**

At Coderio, we value talent regardless of location. We are a remote-first company, passionate about technology, collaborative work, and fair compensation. We offer an inclusive, challenging environment with real opportunities for growth. If you are motivated to build impactful solutions, we’re looking for you.

Apply now.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Data Engineer- Mid Level
jobs.description:
Position Description: Data Engineer

Company: Wize Solutions

Location: [Remote / Hybrid / On-site, City, VA]

Experience: 3-5 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Clearance: Must be able to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance

About Us

Wize Solutions is a Virginia-based IT consulting firm. We deliver Power Platform, RPA, C#/.NET, Power BI, and AI solutions for public and private sector clients.

The Role

We’re looking for a backend-focused data engineer with strong SQL Server experience to join our team supporting a commercial client that does federal work. You’ll build and maintain the ETL pipelines, data warehouse, and SQL jobs that feed the client’s reporting. You won’t be building Power BI reports. You do need to understand how Power BI datasets connect to and depend on the backend, so the data you deliver works well for reporting. You’ll also help protect sensitive data through masking and sound security practices.

What You’ll Do

* Develop and tune SQL Server databases, stored procedures, views, and indexes
* Build and maintain ETL pipelines that move data from source systems into the warehouse
* Support and extend data warehouse models (fact and dimension tables)
* Create and manage SQL Server Agent jobs, schedules, alerts, and failure handling
* Structure backend data so Power BI datasets (semantic models) refresh reliably and perform well
* Work with report developers to troubleshoot refresh failures, slow queries, and data issues that trace back to SQL
* Apply data masking to protect sensitive data in production and non-production environments
* Monitor and resolve performance issues across queries, jobs, and data loads
* Document data flows, job schedules, and data models

What You Bring

* Ability to obtain and maintain a federal security clearance (U.S. citizenship required)
* 3 to 5 years of hands-on SQL Server development
* Strong T-SQL skills, including query tuning and execution plans
* Experience building ETL processes (SSIS or similar tools)
* Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling
* Experience creating and managing SQL Server Agent jobs
* Solid understanding of how Power BI datasets connect to SQL Server (Import vs. DirectQuery, refreshes, gateways) and what the backend needs to support them
* Experience with data masking and handling sensitive data (PII)
* Clear communication with both technical and non-technical people

Nice to Have

* Active federal security clearance
* Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, or Microsoft Fabric experience
* Experience on federal contracts or programs
* Microsoft certifications (DP-203, DP-600, or similar)

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
On this journey for over 12 years, Qventus is leading the transformation of healthcare. We enable hospitals to focus on what matters most: patient care. Our innovative solutions harness the power of machine learning, generative AI, and behavioral science to deliver exceptional outcomes and empower care teams to anticipate and resolve issues before they arise.

Our success in rapid scale across the globe is backed by some of the world's leading investors. At Qventus, you will have the opportunity to work with an exceptional, mission-driven team across the globe, and the ability to directly impact the lives of patients. We're inspired to work with healthcare leaders on our founding vision and unlock world-class medicine through world-class operations. #LI-MB1

Qventus is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to pioneer new data solutions at Qventus. Our Data team ensures that Qventus data users have the data they need to build and drive new and existing Qventus products at scale and cost. This includes bidirectional integration with hospital EMR sources via multiple channels (eg. FHIR), complex highly secure (HIPAA) transformations capable of normalizing information across various workflows and client nuances, integration with & discovery of multiple third party datasets from customer data to big-data claims, and more. Our products span the machine learning based orchestrations, real time hospital reporting, analytical insights, and interactive applications needed to improve the lives of patients and doctors across the country.

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will lead the design, development, and management across investments data assets & data pipelines. You will identify, monitor, and lead initiatives to collect, explore, and model data in close partnership with our data modeling lead and integrations partners. You will work closely with solution experts to design, iterate, and develop strategic enhancements to our Qventus foundational data model. You will be adept in partnering with cross-functional partners and data users to translate functional needs into data requirements and quality checks. You will be data curious and excited to have an impact on the team and in the company and to improve the quality of healthcare operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Spearhead the discovery, evaluation, and integration of new datasets, collaborating (incl. pipeline development and data modeling/documentation) working closely with key data stakeholders to understand their impact and relevance to our core products and the healthcare domain.
* Facilitate the technical management of data assets - clearly tracking and maintaining context on the data within the dataset lifecycle and sustaining tight partnerships with immediate partners on ingestion & solution data engineering
* Translate product / analytical vision into highly functional data pipelines supporting high quality & highly trusted data products (incl. designing data structures, building and scheduling data transformation pipelines, improving transparency etc.).
* Set the standard for data engineering practices within the company, guiding the architectural approaches, data pipeline designs, and the integration of cutting-edge technologies to foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Excellent cross-functional communication - the ability to break down complex technical components for technical and non-technical partners alike
* Innate aptitude for interpreting complex datasets with demonstrated ability to discern underlying patterns, identify anomalies, and extract meaningful insights, demonstrating advanced data intuition and analytical skills. (Healthcare experience preferred)
* Excellence in quality data pipeline design, development, and optimization to create reliable, modular, secure data foundations for the organization's data delivery system from applications to analytics & ML
* Proven ability to independently handle ambiguous project requirements and lead data initiatives from start to finish, while collaborating extensively with cross-functional, non-technical teams to inform and shape product development.

  

**Bonus Points For**

  

* 5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating cloud-based, highly available, observable, and scalable data platforms utilizing large, diverse data sets in production to meet ambiguous business needs
* Relevant industry certifications in a variety of Data Architecture services (Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, AWS Certified Data Engineer or Solutions Architect Professional, SnowPro® Advanced Architect/Data Engineer, Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer, and dbt Analytics Engineering).
* Experience with MLOps and/or developing and maintaining machine learning models and infrastructure
* Experience with data visualization tools and analytics technologies (Sigma, Looker, Tableau, etc.)
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

Qventus values diversity in its workforce and proudly upholds the principles of Equal Opportunity Employment . We welcome all qualified applicants and ensure fair consideration for employment without discrimination based on any legally protected characteristics, including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniformed service member status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy (including childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), national origin or ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics) or any other category protected by federal, state or local law (collectively, "protected characteristics"). **Data Engineer**

**Company Description**

**Redica Systems** is the Intelligence Cloud for life sciences, transforming regulatory complexity into connected, proactive intelligence. Redica's platform helps the world's leading Pharmaceutical and MedTech companies stay inspection-ready, manage supplier risk, and keep pace with evolving global regulations. Built on the Redica Catalyst Platform and powered by Redica ID, Redica unifies the industry's most complete regulatory and inspection datasets, sourced from hundreds of global health authorities, into trusted intelligence for quality and regulatory teams. The Redica Intelligence Cloud brings data together to anticipate risk, accelerate compliance, and enable smarter, faster decisions across the enterprise.

More information is available at redica.com.

 **Job Description**

We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to take a hands-on role in designing, building, and optimizing our core data platform. You'll work on challenging technical problems, help shape architectural decisions, establish engineering best practices, and build scalable, high-quality data pipelines. You'll also have opportunities to mentor fellow engineers, contribute to code reviews, and provide technical guidance as the team grows.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, optimize, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, and microservices for high-volume regulatory and health agency datasets.
* Data Reliability & Integrity: Troubleshoot data quality issues and implement automated testing, monitoring, and validation to ensure data accuracy and reliability.
* Architecture & Design: Contribute to technical design and architectural decisions, building scalable, maintainable solutions that support our evolving data platform.
* System Integration: Integrate data pipelines with downstream NLP/ML services and search technologies, including the ELK stack.
* Production Operations: Support production deployments, troubleshoot pipeline and database issues, and resolve complex technical incidents.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering and Product teams to translate requirements into practical, well-designed technical solutions.

  
**Qualifications**  

* **Tech Savvy:** You effectively anticipate and adopt innovations in business-building technology solutions, staying up-to-date with data advancements and incorporating them into work processes.
* **Manages Complexity:** You actively synthesize solutions from complex information by identifying patterns and developing effective problem-solving strategies to solve data-related problems effectively.
* **Decision Quality:** You consistently make good and timely decisions that propel organizational progress and maintain data integrity.
* **Collaborates:** You actively engage in collaborative problem-solving by leveraging diverse perspectives and finding innovative solutions to achieve shared goals and data engineering initiatives.
* **Optimizes Work Processes:** You actively seek opportunities to enhance and streamline current work processes for managing data pipelines, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and data warehousing.
* **Drives Results:** You strive to continuously improve performance and exceed expectations to contribute to overall success and meet data-related deliverables.
* **Strategic Mindset:** You consistently demonstrate a strategic mindset by envisioning future possibilities and successfully translating them into breakthrough data strategies, contributing to the organization's long-term success.

**Additional Information**

Top Pharmaceutical Companies, Food Manufacturers, MedTech Companies, and Service Firms from around the globe rely on Redica Systems to mine and process government inspection, enforcement, and registration data. This enables them to quantify risk signals from their suppliers, identify market opportunities, benchmark against peers, and prepare for the latest inspection trends.

Our data and analytics have been cited by major media outlets, including MSNBC, *The Wall Street Journal*, and *The Boston Globe*.

Job Description :

**This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S**

The Principal Data Platform Engineer, Snowflake is the platform administrator and technical lead for Enlyte's Snowflake environment and its supporting tooling. This role takes over day-to-day management of the platform, ensuring it is secure, reliable, well-integrated, and supportable as Enlyte's data footprint grows.

This senior individual contributor builds and supports integrations, applies security controls to protect regulated claims data, and partners with tech leads across Technology Engineering & Platforms to establish observability and platform management standards. The role is a key part of the organization's transition to a product delivery model.

**Key Responsibilities:**
=========================

* Administer the Snowflake platform, including accounts, warehouses, databases, environments, configuration, and platform upgrades

* Design, build, and support integrations between Snowflake and source systems, AWS services, and downstream consumers
* Implement and maintain platform security controls, including network policies, encryption, data masking, and audit logging, in partnership with the Security team
* Partner with tech leads to establish observability for the platform, including monitoring, alerting, usage, and performance visibility
* Monitor platform health and performance; troubleshoot issues and support resolution of Snowflake-related incidents
* Automate administrative tasks and support platform configuration as code (Terraform, CI/CD) where applicable
* Track platform consumption and identify opportunities to optimize warehouse sizing and credit usage

* Serve as the technical point of contact for the Snowflake vendor relationship, including support cases, roadmap, and new feature evaluation

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, database administration, or data platform roles
* 3+ years of hands-on experience administering Snowflake in a production enterprise environment
* Strong experience building and supporting data integrations (Snowpipe, connectors, APIs, ETL/ELT tooling)
* Strong cloud engineering experience, primarily AWS, including the services that integrate with Snowflake
* Strong SQL skills and scripting experience (Python or similar)
* Experience implementing security controls for sensitive or regulated data (PHI/PII, HIPAA)
* Strong communication skills with the ability to partner with and influence technical leaders

**Preferred Qualifications:**
=============================

* SnowPro Core and SnowPro Advanced: Administrator or Architect certification
* Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools for Snowflake management
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools for data platforms
* Experience with dbt, Airflow, or similar data orchestration and transformation tools
* Experience in insurance, claims, healthcare, or financial services technology environments
* Experience with organizational transformation from project-based to product/service delivery models

Benefits:

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $133,000 - $170,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

*The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.*

**Role: .NET Data Engineer**

**Work Type: Remote**

*Job Description*

**Role Overview**

The .NET Data Engineer will own the data backbone of an AI-driven submission management and Reserving platform for an insurance company . The .NET data engineer will be responsible for integrating, transforming, and consolidating data from various structured and unstructured sources into formats suitable for analytics and reporting. They design and maintain data pipelines, data warehouses, and high-performance data stores, ensuring data integrity, efficiency, and reliability according to business requirements

The candidate must be working primarily in C#/.NET, SQL Server, and Azure, with React on the front end, with preference for candidates who understand insurance and reserving concepts.

**Must-Have Skills**

**Data Import, ETL & SQL**

* Design repeatable processes to import data from CSV files and external APIs into SQL Server tables, then transform and cleanse it into production tables.
* Write and maintain SQL stored procedures (SPs) for data migration and transformation, using parameters and variables so the same procedure can be reused across data sources, environments, or business units (LOBs).
* Ensure stored procedures and .NET import tools are safely re-runnable (idempotent) handling duplicates, missing data, and partial failures without corrupting data.

**API & Third-Party Integrations**

* Build and maintain .NET services that integrate with third-party APIs (e.g., Salesforce) for data enrichment and synchronization.
* Handle authentication flows (OAuth client credentials, Bearer tokens) and design request/response models that map cleanly to C# classes.

**.NET Application Development**

* Design and build .NET / C# applications — Azure Functions (isolated worker model) and console utilities — that call external APIs, process data in bulk, and write results to SQL Server.
* Use dependency injection, configuration binding (appsettings.json, User Secrets, Azure App Configuration, Key Vault), and structured logging as standard patterns across all new services.
* Implement asynchronous, concurrent processing (async/await, SemaphoreSlim-based bounded concurrency) to handle bulk data volumes efficiently without overwhelming downstream APIs.
* Build resilient HTTP client code: authentication (OAuth/Bearer tokens), retry logic with backoff for transient failures, and proper error handling so a single bad record does not break an entire batch run.
* Work with Entity Framework Core and LINQ queries for reading and writing application data in SQL Server.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests for data-processing logic.

**React – Front End**

* Strong experience in React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and front-end best practices, with the ability to build responsive, scalable, and high-performance user interfaces.
* Develop and maintain web applications using React.js; build reusable UI components and front-end libraries for future use.
* Collaborate with backend developers to deliver high-quality, end-to-end solutions.

**Data Quality, DevOps & Documentation**

* Validate data accuracy after each import/migration run (row counts, key-field checks, spot-checks against source data).
* Use Git for version control (branching, pull requests) and Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for CI/CD (build, test, multi-environment deployment).
* Document data flows, mapping logic, and known data quality issues for the rest of the team.

**Reporting & KPIs**

* Build and maintain KPI queries/views and reporting datasets to support business and operational dashboards.
* Work with stakeholders to translate reporting requirements into reliable, well-documented SQL views or stored procedures.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

**Insurance Domain Knowledge**

* Familiarity with commercial insurance and underwriting concepts and the submission lifecycle (intake, triage, clearance, referral, quote).
* Understanding of common insurance data structures and documents, such as ACORD forms, loss runs, and statements of value (SOVs).
* Exposure to broker, policy, and submission data models.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Experience:

* Data engineer: 10 years (Required)
* .NET: 4 years (Required)
* databricks: 3 years (Required)
* ETL: 3 years (Required)
* Azure: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote
