**Lead Data Engineer**

**About us:**

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.  
  
**Position Overview:**  
The Lead Data Engineer owns Fullbay's data platform end to end. Fullbay runs a Snowflake data warehouse that serves organizational reporting across two live products and acts as the primary read plane for AI agents. This role owns the architecture of that platform, builds it out hands-on, and holds the authority to set standards and revise the design as the business changes.

At its core this is an enablement role. Business users and AI agents increasingly self-serve against Fullbay data, and the Lead Data Engineer is what makes that self-service trustworthy, through certified metric definitions, a well-governed semantic layer, and disciplined platform standards. The role reports directly to the VP of IT with the charter to set data standards company-wide.

**The Right Wrench for the Job**  
Every heavy-duty shop runs on one set of specs. Torque values, part numbers, and service intervals only work when the tech, the service writer, and the parts counter all read from the same manual. When two people have two different numbers for the same bolt, the truck comes back. That's this role, but for the numbers Fullbay runs on: the definitions behind every report, for two live products and for the AI agents that now read the data as readily as people do.

You're the right fit if you've owned a production data platform and know the difference between a metric that's documented and one that's trusted. You can declare a grain and defend it in the morning, ship tested SQL through version control by noon, and tell an executive no, with the reasoning, before the end of the day. You treat documentation as the deliverable, because you may be the only person who knows how something works, and you're curious about what it takes to make company data something agents can rely on.

This isn't the role for someone who wants to build reports on request, or who needs a data team, a finished design, and a scoped backlog to lean on. If your instinct is to say yes to every ask and sort out the definition later, this isn't your shop. But if you're the kind of person who will set the standard, hold the line on it, and write it down so the next person can pick it up without a phone call, we'd like to talk.

  

**Primary Duties & Responsibilities:**

* Certified Definitions & Semantic Layer: Own the metric and entity definitions the whole company reports from and serve as the final arbiter when functions disagree on a definition. Keep documentation current enough that a business user finds the right answer without needing to ask — this is the center of the role, not a component of it.
* Gold Layer Ownership: Build and extend Fullbay’s gold layer hands-on, writing SQL and transformation code in version control with automated tests.
* Identity Resolution: Own identity resolution across our Classic, Next, and Salesforce platforms, including crosswalk logic, survivorship rules, and platform-of-record determination over time. A permanent responsibility, not a one-time migration task.
* Snowflake Platform Ownership: Own Snowflake’s role hierarchy and grants, row access and masking policies, warehouse sizing, and cost attribution and spend.
* Agent Enablement: Design curated access paths for AI agents as first-class data consumers, including per-agent identities and grants, a registration pattern, and a retention policy for agent-produced data.
* Source Ingestion: Onboard new data sources to documented patterns, own schema drift and deletion detection, and partner with engineering on source schema changes.
* Vendor Direction: Scope and direct the retained architecture consultant’s ongoing work — writing specs, reviewing deliverables against approved standards, and rejecting nonconforming work.
* Self-Serve Enablement: Provide guidance and office hours for business users and AI builders to self-serve against the data platform. This role explicitly does not build reports on request.
* Documentation: Treat documentation as a core deliverable, not an afterthought. With no second data employee, documentation is Fullbay’s continuity plan for this function.
* Adheres to all confidentiality and compliance regulations.
* Performs other duties as assigned.
  

**Minimum Education & Work Experience:**

* 7+ years of data engineering experience, including demonstrated ownership of a production data platform, required.
* Deep dimensional modeling experience required: able to declare a grain, defend historization choices per attribute, and articulate a restatement policy.
* Experience with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud data warehouse) beyond SQL — warehouse strategy, cost management, RBAC, and environment design — required.
* Experience building transformations as version-controlled code with automated tests and CI required.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
* Experience with change data capture and incremental extraction from application databases required.
* Experience with entity resolution across systems with independent identifiers required.

* Comfortable being the only person who knows how something works, and documents accordingly.
* Willing to say no to a vendor, an app team, or an executive, and ability to explain why.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - US Remote
jobs.description:
#### **What is PerfectServe?**

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.  
  
PerfectServe's mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.  
  
Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:

* In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.

* PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.  
  
If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

**About the role**
------------------

Join a new, small team building PerfectServe's data platform.

We are building the pipelines and models that bring data together from across PerfectServe's product portfolio. You will work closely with a staff data engineer and a platform engineer, with enough ownership to see your work in production and enough support to learn quickly.

The source systems are varied, so the work spans extending established pipelines and designing new ones from scratch. That range is a good part of the job.

**Why this role, specifically**
-------------------------------

Joining a platform in its first months is a different experience from joining one that is five years old. The patterns are still being set, which means your questions change them. You will see the whole path — a production source system at one end, someone making a decision at the other — rather than one layer of a stack somebody else assembled.

You will have a dedicated team to work with and learn from so the ownership comes without being thrown in unsupported.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from production source systems
* Write transformation models that turn raw data into datasets people can trust
* Apply dimensional and medallion modelling patterns as the warehouse takes shape
* Deploy pipelines to production, and test them properly — idempotency, data quality checks
* Contribute to data model and schema design, and to design reviews
* Document what you build, including runbooks for the pipelines you own

**What you bring**
------------------

* Professional experience building data pipelines, with production ownership of at least some
* Strong SQL, and a working programming language — Python, Go or equivalent
* Hands-on dbt, or another transformation framework
* A cloud data warehouse — Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or similar
* Practical ELT and orchestration experience (Fivetran, Airflow or equivalent)
* Working AWS knowledge — object storage, access basics, and enough networking to reason about where data moves
* A testing instinct for data, not only for code

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Change-data-capture
* SQL Server sources
* Healthcare or another regulated data environment
* Exposure to a BI or semantic layer

#### **Why Join PerfectServe?**

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You'll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of **$115,000–$140,000 USD** per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations.

#### **Benefits:**

* Remote first work environment
* Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
* 401K - with match and immediately vested.
* 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
* Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe's cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description:
The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.

We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

  

Protective is looking for a Lead Data Engineer to set the technical direction for a delivery pod building data products on Voyager, our Databricks lakehouse on Azure. You will lead the design of data products through the full medallion architecture — Bronze ingestion, Silver conformance, and Gold consumption — and be accountable for whether those products hold up for the consumers who depend on them.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a people-management or project-management role. You will still write and review production code daily. What you own is how the pod’s data products are designed, modeled, contracted, and tested, and the standard the pod holds itself to. The Product Owner owns the backlog and the Scrum Master owns the sprint; you own the engineering.

On Voyager, the medallion layers are named Raw, Prep, and Prod. They map directly to Bronze, Silver, and Gold and are used interchangeably in this description.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Design and modeling**

* Lead the design of data products end to end: what gets ingested, how it is cleansed and conformed, how it is modeled, and what the Gold layer looks like to the people querying it.
* Own dimensional design — grain, natural and surrogate keys, Type 2 history, facts, bridges, and conformed dimensions shared across the pod’s products.
* Set the pod’s position on where logic belongs: what is cleaned in Silver, what is business logic in Gold, and what is a consumer’s own concern.
* Keep models as simple as the questions require, and push back on designs that will not hold.
* Partner with ML engineering where the pod’s Gold layer is the training or feature source for a model, so those datasets are contracted, versioned, and reproducible like any other consumer-facing product.

**Data contracts and consumer compatibility**

* Own the pod’s ODCS data contracts as real interfaces: named owners, named consumers, enforceable quality rules, freshness and update expectations, and an explicit breaking-change policy.
* Make the compatibility call on every proposed contract change, and drive consumer notification when a change is genuinely breaking.
* Represent the pod’s contracts in cross-domain conversations, where one pod’s Gold layer is another team’s dependency.

Standards, quality, and operations  

* Set and hold the pod’s engineering standards for Python, SQL, dbt, testing, model structure, naming, and repository conventions — consistent with the platform’s paved paths and Azure DevOps CI gates rather than in competition with them.
* Lead code review. Be the reviewer who catches the modeling mistake, the missing test, and the change that will break a consumer, and who explains why so the pod learns it.
* Ensure quality rules are enforced in tests and asset checks rather than asserted in documentation, and that pipeline health is observable without someone going to look — freshness, volume, latency, and cost instrumented, and alerting set against the SLAs and SLOs the pod’s contracts commit to.
* Own the pod’s operational posture for its own pipelines: failure diagnosis, data-issue triage, backfills, cost and performance tuning, on-call coverage and escalation, root-cause analysis, and runbooks someone other than the author can execute.
* Keep the pod’s delivery inside the control expectations of a regulated carrier: change management through pull request and pipeline, segregation of duties between authoring and deploying, least-privilege access, and audit evidence that falls out of CI/CD rather than being assembled for an auditor.
* Develop reusable frameworks, templates, and patterns that raise the pod’s consistency and delivery speed.

**Delivery leadership**

* Partner with the Product Owner and Scrum Master on decomposition and refinement: turn use cases and features into estimable, grounded stories with testable acceptance criteria and an identified target layer and repository.
* Hold the Definition of Ready before the pod commits and the Definition of Done before the pod calls something finished — merged and approved code, passing CI and coverage gates, and evidence that the outcome is real.
* Identify unknowns that need a spike rather than an estimate, and say so during planning rather than mid-sprint.

**Mentorship and collaboration**

* Grow the engineers on the pod through design review, pairing, and code review rather than by taking the hard work yourself.
* Bring new engineers up to productive speed on the platform’s conventions and tooling, and reduce single points of knowledge — no data product that only one person understands.
* Work with the platform team on capability gaps: when the pod needs something the platform does not yet offer, raise it as a demand signal rather than building a private workaround.
* Partner with the DataOps/MLOps Lead on the shared CI/CD, orchestration, and observability standards — adopt and strengthen the paved path rather than forking it, and be the pod’s voice on what it is still missing.
* Work with data architecture and governance on solution shape, Unity Catalog placement, and access requirements.

### **Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered.
* 6+ years building and operating production data pipelines and consumer-facing data models, from source ingestion through to published data products.
* Strong hands-on Python and SQL, with the credibility to make design calls and the willingness to still write and review code.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable Spark-based lakehouse, including Delta Lake, MERGE, incremental process

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Anika Systems is an outcome-driven technology solutions firm that guides federal agencies in solving complex business challenges and preparing for the future. Our services span AI Strategy, Data Intelligence, AI & Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Enterprise Platforms and Engineering, with a specialized focus on National Security and Federal Financial programs. We are dedicated to delivering forward-thinking solutions that accelerate the critical missions of our government clients. This position is 100% remote.  
  
**Position Summary**  
We are in search of a highly collaborative and experiencedData Analyst to support the Office of Chief Data Officer (OCDO) and the Office of Performance Quality (OPQ) for a federal government contract. In this role, you will design and maintain robust data pipelines, perform in-depth analysis of large-scale datasets, and deliver actionable insights that drive mission decisions. You will work within a Databricks environment leveraging SQL, PySpark, and Python, to transform raw agency data into reliable, governed, and analytics-ready assets. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government, or Google Cloud for Government.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines, including automated testing and deployment using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Working knowledge of data visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI) and experience connecting them to Databricks SQL endpoints.
* Familiarity with Unity Catalog for data access control, lineage, and governance within Databricks.

On Voyager, the medallion layers are named Raw, Prep, and Prod. They map directly to Bronze, Silver, and Gold and are used interchangeably in this description.

jobs.description:
As a Database Engineer on the Professional Archive team, you'll operate as a subject-matter expert for the data infrastructure that powers our platform – driving the architecture, scaling, and reliability decisions that keep high-velocity, compliance-critical systems performant and secure. You'll work with SQL Server environments spanning multi-terabyte data volumes, tables with billions of rows, and sustained throughput exceeding 100,000 transactions per second.

You'll work independently through ambiguous and unfamiliar problems, set technical direction for real-time data pipelines and system performance, and act as a go-to resource for engineers across the wider organization. Your work will directly shape how Smarsh clients meet their compliance needs through scalable, dependable data and search capabilities.

You'll partner with leaders across Product Management, Engineering, and Site Reliability, weighing a range of inputs to resolve complex challenges and influence strategy beyond your immediate team. We're looking for someone who brings deep technical judgment, mentors others, and is motivated to make an impact through thoughtful, high-leverage engineering.

### **How will you contribute?**

* Serve as a subject-matter expert for database architecture and performance, guiding engineers through complex or ambiguous technical problems where established principles don't fully apply
* Set the technical approach for scalable data solutions, partnering with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, and Site Reliability to shape direction rather than simply implement it
* Drive larger, cross-functional projects from design through delivery, proactively identifying and addressing upstream and downstream impacts before they become issues
* Informally mentor other engineers, modeling sound engineering discipline and raising the technical bar for the wider team
* Shape how the team adopts modern engineering practices, including Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps principles
* Review code and database changes with an eye for systemic risk and performance, while also leading efforts to pay down technical debt across systems

* Deep expertise designing logical and physical data models, including schema design and data relationships, at a level others rely on for direction
* A demonstrated ability to set database performance strategy by tuning queries and indexes and establishing standards that others follow
* Strong command of data security practices (encryption, access controls, auditing), with the ability to shape how the team approaches them
* A track record of independently troubleshooting complex issues in systems that require high availability, serving as an escalation point for others
* Ability to plan for data growth and scale infrastructure with the full flow of work in mind, not just the immediate ask

  + Experience designing for horizontal as well as vertical scalability, anticipating data growth before it becomes a production risk

  + Experience with cloud database platforms (e.g., AWS RDS/Aurora, MongoDB Atlas) is a plus

### **What do we offer?**

This role applies a deep understanding of Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and supports complex data flows between systems while prioritizing data integrity and security. The Application Integration Engineer defines and supports Enterprise IT's automation goals using industry best practices and methodologies for code management, configuration, and orchestration. Partners with external departments, teams, and users to provide cross-functional solutions that benefit the company. * Design, develop, test, implement, maintain, and support secure data flow between enterprise information systems and their related applications. Systems include HCM and ERP, CRM, and IAM.
* Assist in the evaluation, selection, and implementation of new software and systems that integrate with enterprise applications.
* Review existing integrations and recommend optimizations that maximize data integrity, process efficiency, and user experience.

* Create and update policies and procedures to define security standards and minimum requirements of API integrations.

**What you'll need to Succeed:**

jobs.description:
**Integration Engineer**

**Location:** Irwindale, CA (100% remote flexibility is an option)

**About the Role**
------------------

Rize Credit Union is looking for an Integration Engineer to build and operate the integrations and automated processes that connect our core, ancillary, and SaaS applications. An automated process is only as capable as the systems it can reach and only as trustworthy as the controls around it, and this role owns both.

You will design, build, deploy, monitor, and retire integrations. You will also expose internal and vendor applications as governed, authenticated, least-privilege services. Working closely with our business analysts, who identify and shape automation opportunities, you will decide what should be automated, what should not, and how to do it safely in a regulated financial institution.

This position is based out of our headquarters in Irwindale, CA, with the flexibility to work 100% remotely. You will report to the Director, Business Technology.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Design, build, and maintain integrations using our iPaaS platform, REST and SOAP APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, and AWS services (e.g., Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions)
* Build and maintain API wrappers and connectors, with accurate specifications and documentation
* Choose the right approach for each opportunity (deterministic integration, conventional code, or a change to a human process) and document your rationale
* Establish how integrations authenticate and what they are permitted to do, including scoped IAM permissions, credential vaulting, and rotation
* Define controls and action boundaries for every integration, and treat all external data as untrusted input
* Build automated test suites and track error, latency, and failure metrics
* Instrument integrations with logging, monitoring, alerting, and runbooks so every action can be reconstructed for troubleshooting, audit, and regulatory examination
* Maintain the technical inventory of integrations, automated processes, and APIs, and retire what is unused or superseded
* Work with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance to review integrations before production release, including member data handling and third-party and open-source components
* Keep all code in source control with peer review, testing, and CI/CD, and document architecture and reusable patterns so knowledge is shared

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 4–7 years of experience building and operating production software, integrations, or automation, with strong hands-on Python
* Demonstrated experience integrating systems through REST APIs, including authentication patterns (e.g., OAuth 2.0, JWT, API keys), error handling, retries, idempotency, and rate limiting
* Experience deploying and supporting workloads in AWS
* Experience with version control, peer code review, automated testing, and CI/CD practices
* Working knowledge of SQL, AWS services for integration workloads, and containerization
* Sound judgment about what an automated process should and should not be permitted to do
* A security-first mindset, with default assumptions of least privilege and untrusted input
* Ability to explain the capabilities and limits of automation honestly to non-technical stakeholders, including recommending against automation when that is the right answer
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel)
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent demonstrated experience and a reviewable portfolio of built work will be considered in lieu of a degree.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

* Financial services or credit union experience
* Administration and development on an iPaaS platform
* Event-driven architecture on AWS (e.g., SQS, SNS) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform)
* Experience with test automation, logging, and monitoring tooling
* Identity and secrets management (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Amazon Cognito, AWS Secrets Manager) and API gateway patterns
* Familiarity with NCUA expectations and GLBA and nonpublic personal information handling

**Pay**
-------

The pay range for this position in California is **$87,500 – $121,000 per year**. Actual pay will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------

Rize Federal Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer of women, minorities, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.

jobs.description:
### **About Mainspring**

Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

* Pragmatic Optimism
* Excellence without Ego
* Proactive Collaboration

### **Job Overview**

Site Integration Engineers report to the Project Engineering Manager within the Project Delivery department. A key enabler of Mainspring’s mission is the ability of its team to deliver solutions based on our linear generator technology that solve customer problems in the cross-section of resiliency and clean power supply.

The project engineering team provides the technical expertise, guidance, and support to deploy linear generators into the field efficiently—building customer confidence and enabling future scalability. This role owns site-level readiness after construction is complete, ensuring that all mechanical, electrical, control, and communication systems are fully integrated, validated, and ready to transition into commissioning and operation. Generator commissioning is performed by a separate team; this role ensures the site is ready for it. Acting as the technical integration authority on site, this role bridges engineering design intent and real-world system operation.

### **Responsibilities**

This role will be responsible for:

* Interpreting technical project details, including scopes of work, sequences of operation, control narratives, and engineering drawings (site plans, P&IDs, single-line, and three-line diagrams), and serving as the controls subject matter expert in design reviews
* Verifying relay settings, meter configurations, and controller programming delivered by third-party integrators against approved settings files and design documents
* Owning site readiness on assigned projects by validating installation quality and accuracy of balance-of-plant systems such as fuel, electrical, metering, protection relays, and communications; developing punch lists and driving issues to closure when discrepancies are found
* Validating electrical and mechanical installations against drawings and specifications by witnessing and/or reviewing results of checks such as wiring and termination verification, grounding, insulation resistance and continuity testing, phase rotation, and electrical acceptance test (NETA) reports; and equipment setting and anchoring, gas piping pressure and leak tests, purging, ventilation and exhaust, and fuel regulator setup
* Configuring equipment and verifying functional readiness of site-level control and communication systems prior to energization, including troubleshooting industrial communication networks (e.g., Modbus TCP/IP, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, OPC-UA)
* Supporting integration with customer PLC/SCADA/HMI platforms (e.g., Ignition, SEL RTAC, Siemens WinCC, AVEVA Wonderware, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Schneider EcoStruxure) for system monitoring and control
* Coordinating handoff to the generator commissioning team, confirming all site-level prerequisites are complete before units are started, and keeping project stakeholders updated on readiness status and next steps
* Planning Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and system-level validation, defining acceptance criteria for customer and utility witness testing, and confirming that as-built operation matches design intent
* Supporting Permission to Operate (PTO) by compiling documentation based on utility requirements and building an accurate submission package for the Interconnection team to issue to the utility
* Owning site QA/QC documentation and ensuring systems are fully validated and ready for turnover to operations and the customer
* Establishing repeatable processes, including ready-for-commissioning and ready-for-testing checklists, lookahead dashboards, SAT templates, equipment configuration and how-to guides, site procedures, etc
* Travelling to project sites as needed to confirm readiness and perform necessary testing

### **Job Qualifications and Experience**

* B.S. degree in Electrical, Controls, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. Equivalent field experience may be substituted
* 5+ years in pre-commissioning, site commissioning, field applications, or controls engineering on power generation, battery storage, solar, microgrid, or industrial facility projects
* Experience configuring, integrating, and troubleshooting devices and platforms such as:
  + Protective relays and automation controllers: SEL (relays, RTAC), GE Multilin, Beckwith, or ABB.
  + Revenue and power quality meters: SEL-735, Schneider ION, GE kV2c, or Itron
  + PLCs: Allen-Bradley ControlLogix/CompactLogix, Siemens S7, or Schneider Modicon
  + SCADA/HMI: Ignition, Siemens WinCC, AVEVA (Wonderware), or Rockwell FactoryTalk View
* Working knowledge of industrial communication protocols (Modbus TCP/IP, EtherNet/IP, Profibus, OPC-UA, DNP3) and OT networking
* Ability to interpret single-line and three-line diagrams, P&IDs, control narratives, and sequences of operation
* Understanding of balance-of-plant systems, including fuel/gas, low- and medium-voltage electrical, metering, protection, and communications, with the ability to read construction plan sets and acceptance test reports and a working knowledge of NEC and NFPA 37/54
* Experience planning and documenting Site Acceptance Testing and supporting utility witness testing for PTO
* Familiarity with field safety practices and energization standards and procedures (e.g., NFPA 70E, lockout/tagout), including Lockout/Ta

jobs.title: Recruiting Systems & Data Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Overview**

**The Role**

We’re looking for a Recruiting Systems & Data Integration Engineer to build and operate the connections between engin and our customers’ recruiting systems.

You will own integrations across the full recruiting lifecycle. At the top of the funnel, you will synchronize jobs for distribution and ingest applications, candidate profiles, resumes, and related data so Suzy, our AI agent, can analyze and interview candidates. Further down the funnel, you will capture events such as submissions, interviews, offers, placements, starts, and hires so customers can measure performance, attribution, and recruiting outcomes.

This role goes beyond traditional ATS integrations. ATS platforms vary widely in their APIs, data models, reporting capabilities, and integration maturity. When a standard integration through platforms such as Merge or Kombo is insufficient, you will determine the most reliable alternative. That may involve working directly with an ATS API, using webhooks or exports, processing XML feeds, or engineering agentic integration workflows when no clear API path is available.

You will own these integration problems from investigation through production operation.

**What You’ll Do**

* Build, maintain, and improve integrations between engin and customer ATS platforms.
* Synchronize jobs and their associated requirements, locations, compensation details, and status changes for distribution through engin.
* Ingest applications, candidate profiles, resumes, screening responses, and related records needed by Suzy to analyze and interview candidates.
* Reliably return relevant results and updates from engin and Suzy to customer systems.
* Capture downstream recruiting events such as submissions, interviews, offers, placements, starts, and hires.
* Translate different ATS data models and customer workflows into a consistent model spanning jobs, candidates, applications, activities, and outcomes.
* Build the data foundation for recruitment marketing attribution, funnel analysis, conversion measurement, and operational KPIs.
* Work with unified integration platforms such as Merge and Kombo while recognizing when their abstractions do not expose the required functionality or data.
* Integrate directly with ATS APIs, webhooks, reporting systems, scheduled exports, and other available interfaces.
* Design secure, maintainable agentic solutions for systems where conventional API-based integration is unavailable or incomplete.
* Build workflows to ingest, validate, transform, and produce XML data feeds.
* Operate high-volume synchronization workflows, including bulk imports, incremental updates, backfills, retries, and reconciliation.
* Handle pagination, rate limits, long-running jobs, partial failures, duplicate records, and inconsistent source data.
* Monitor integration health and investigate discrepancies between customer systems and engin.
* Create internal tooling that helps engineering and customer-facing teams diagnose integration issues.
* Partner with product, customer success, and engineering to define customer-specific integration requirements.
* Design integrations that protect sensitive candidate and customer data through secure authentication, least-privilege access, appropriate logging, and responsible data retention.
* Lead technical discovery and troubleshooting conversations with customer stakeholders during onboarding and ongoing operation, explaining complex integration issues clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Work agent-first using tools such as Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code for implementation, investigation, testing, and documentation.
* Document integration architecture, customer configurations, data mappings, operational procedures, and known system limitations.

**Why This Role Matters**

ATS integrations are the foundation of engin’s product experience. Jobs must flow accurately into engin for distribution, and applications and candidate data must be available to Suzy so she can analyze, screen, and interview candidates effectively. The resulting activity and outcomes must then flow back into customer systems.

Customers also need visibility into what happens throughout the recruiting lifecycle—from job distribution and candidate acquisition through submissions, interviews, placements, and hires. Accurate, timely data enables automation, improves the candidate experience, and allows customers to understand the return on their recruiting efforts.

You will build the infrastructure that connects this entire lifecycle, even when the underlying ATS makes it difficult.

**Pay range:** **$120000 to $145000 per year**
----------------------------------------------

### **Required skills**

* Professional experience building ATS, HR technology, or recruiting-system integrations.
* Familiarity with one or more ATS platforms such as Bullhorn, Avionté, JobDiva, Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, iCIMS, or SmartRecruiters.
* Experience integrating third-party systems through REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, scheduled jobs, file transfers, or data exports.
* Strong Node.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL skills.
* Experience modeling and synchronizing interconnected records such as jobs, candidates, applications, submissions, and placements.
* Experience designing data synchronization systems where correctness, idempotency, throughput, and recovery from partial failures matter.
* Experience processing large volumes of operational data through batching, pagination, incremental synchronization, and backfills.
* Ability to investigate unfamiliar systems, understand inconsistent data models, and turn ambiguous requirements into reliable solutions.
* Strong debugging skills across authentication, data mapping, API behavior, synchronization state, and data quality.
* A practical approach to engineering reliable systems without unnecessary complexity.
* Comfort owning customer integration problems from initial discovery through deployment and ongoing sup

jobs.description:
Join our team and experience how we lead with passion, positivity, and accountability to deliver the Right Talent. Right Now. We create an environment where you can think big, have fun and truly make a difference.

For more than 40 years, Oxford Global Resources has helped organizations solve complex business and technical challenges by connecting them with specialized expertise. We work across industries including technology, life sciences, engineering, and healthcare, providing services that range from individual staffing support to co-managed projects and fully managed programs.

Our work is built on understanding what each organization needs and bringing the right people and approach to the challenge. Behind that work are teams across Oxford who strengthen how we operate, support our people, and help us deliver for clients. If you’re looking for a place where your work connects to a larger purpose and has a visible impact, there’s an opportunity to do that here.

**What We’re Looking For**

We’re looking for a hands-on Data Engineering Lead to guide our data engineering team and shape the next stage of Oxford’s enterprise data platform. Reporting to the Director of Data Operations, you’ll lead a team of two to four engineers while remaining closely involved in architecture, development, troubleshooting, and delivery.

Oxford’s data environment spans Azure and Microsoft Fabric. Your mandate is to connect those ecosystems thoughtfully, reduce redundancy, and build a clear path toward a strong, consolidated Fabric platform without disrupting the business. You’ll set engineering standards, strengthen platform reliability, and partner across analytics, technology, and the business to turn changing requirements into dependable data products.

**Remote, Eastern U.S. | Exempt | Reports to the Director of Data Operations**

**What You’ll Do:**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers through clear priorities, project planning, code reviews, coaching, and career development.
* Own the platform strategy across Azure and Microsoft Fabric, identifying overlapping pipelines, storage, and tooling and creating a practical roadmap to consolidate or retire redundant components.

* Build and mature Oxford’s Microsoft Fabric platform, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, and OneLake, while defining what should remain in Azure and what should move into Fabric.
* Develop complex T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and database solutions while managing, monitoring, and optimizing SQL Server database environments for performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Design, optimize, test, and maintain the stored procedures that support Oxford’s core ETL processes, with disciplined version control and performance management.
* Manage transformation pipelines end to end, including orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, failure handling, troubleshooting, and recovery.

* Manage platform reliability, performance, and cloud cost while applying sound governance practices around access, lineage, compliance, and PII handling.
* Evaluate emerging tools and approaches, make clear build-versus-buy recommendations, and communicate priorities, risks, tradeoffs, and progress to technical and nontechnical leaders.

* Five or more years of data engineering experience, including at least two years leading engineers formally or as a technical lead.

We are currently looking for a **SQL Developer / Data Analyst** for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) by providing SQL development, data analysis, reporting, and data quality monitoring for ongoing electronic health record (EHR) modernization initiatives. The developer will work with large clinical and operational datasets, supporting data migration, integration, validation, and business intelligence reporting using SQL Server, Power BI, and related technologies.

The position operates within a remote, multidisciplinary Agile team, collaborating with software developers, data engineers, quality assurance personnel, and federal stakeholders. The developer will participate in data analysis, reporting, validation, and continuous improvement activities to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of healthcare data throughout modernization and migration efforts.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize advanced SQL queries, scripts, and transformation logic to support data extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis across large clinical and operational datasets within SQL Server environments.
* Analyze and interpret healthcare data from multiple systems, identify trends and anomalies, and develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and related business intelligence tools to support program reporting and decision-making.
* Collaborate with developers, data engineers, and program stakeholders to evaluate data flows, source-to-target mappings, transformation requirements, and conceptual and physical data models supporting federal healthcare data warehouses and integration initiatives.
* Develop and maintain data quality monitoring processes, validation routines, and reconciliation reports to assess data completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness throughout migration and EHR modernization activities.
* Investigate data discrepancies, perform exploratory data analysis and root cause investigations, document findings, and maintain technical documentation, including data dictionaries, mapping specifications, runbooks, and validation protocols.
* Support recurring reporting deliverables and evaluate AI-assisted tools for SQL optimization, automated data quality checks, anomaly detection, and technical documentation while validating generated outputs and maintaining data security and quality standards.
* Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

**Requirements:**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electronics Engineering, or another engineering or technical discipline, or eight (8) years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree, with a minimum of five (5) years of relevant professional experience.

Strong hands-on experience developing advanced SQL queries, scripts, and data extraction processes using Microsoft SQL Server, including working with large, complex datasets and optimizing query performance.

Experience analyzing healthcare or clinical datasets, including familiarity with healthcare data standards and systems such as HL7, FHIR, or VistA, and supporting data validation, transformation, and integration activities.

Strong understanding of relational database structures, data modeling, indexing, normalization, and performance tuning, with experience developing reports and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or Microsoft Excel.

Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, and ensure data accuracy and integrity.

Strong written and verbal communication, documentation, and collaboration skills with the ability to present technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.

**Additional Qualifications:**

* Previous experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) healthcare data systems, including VX130, Oracle Health Millennium, or the Corporate Data Warehouse (CDW), and familiarity with InterSystems IRIS, Caché, mirrored database architectures, or EHR data migration and cutover verification activities.
* Experience working within Agile development environments using JIRA, Azure DevOps, or similar tools, with knowledge of healthcare data governance, metadata management, source-to-target mapping, data quality monitoring, and technical documentation practices.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools such as GitHub Copilot to develop and optimize SQL queries, generate data validation and reconciliation scripts, identify anomalies, analyze trends, and produce technical documentation, with an understanding of AI output validation, PHI/PII protection, and responsible AI practices within federal healthcare environments.

**Security Clearance Requirements:**

* U.S. Citizenship is required.
* All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

**Benefits:**

* Medical/Dental/Vision
* 401k with Employer Match
* PTO + Federal Holidays
* Corporate Laptop
* Training Opportunities
* Remote Opportunity

jobs.title: SQL Developer / Database Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced SQL Developer / Database Engineer to support ATLAS, the VA’s open-architected, multi-cloud enterprise data management and analytics platform. In this role, you will design, maintain, integrate, and optimize SQL database structures, transformation logic, and data pipelines that ingest, condition, curate, and deliver multi-source data as secure, reusable enterprise data products. You will use SQL Server, Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines, Databricks, Starburst, and Azure Data Lake Service to improve data reliability, performance, and interoperability across ATLAS and connected source platforms. You will troubleshoot discrepancies and ETL/ELT failures, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and help provide consistent access to trusted data that supports analytics, evidence-based decisions, and better outcomes for Veterans and their families.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, install, configure, maintain, and optimize SQL database systems and related data structures supporting ATLAS.
* Develop, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot ETL/ELT workflows and data pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Synapse Pipelines.
* Integrate structured and unstructured data from databases, APIs, cloud platforms, and other enterprise sources into Azure Data Lake Service.
* Create and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, database objects, and transformation logic for data conditioning and curation.
* Use Databricks and Starburst to query, transform, and integrate distributed data across lakehouse and enterprise data sources.
* Investigate data discrepancies, pipeline failures, and performance issues; perform root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes.
* Apply data-quality controls and support metadata management and data cataloging using Collibra.
* Monitor database and pipeline performance; perform query tuning, indexing, backup, recovery, patching, and reliability improvements.
* Support secure, consistent, and compliant access to enterprise data through appropriate identity, authorization, and data-protection controls.
* Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and product teams to create consumable data products and enable Azure ML/AI services.
* Support reporting and visualization needs using Pyramid Analytics and Power BI, including validation of underlying data structures and accuracy.
* Translate business requirements into technical specifications and communicate solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Document database structures, data mappings, pipelines, operational procedures, and technical decisions.
* Participate actively in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and support continuous improvement of ATLAS data services.

  
Requirements:  
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum five (5) years of experience in database development, administration, and maintenance.
* Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including complex SQL queries, stored procedures, database design, indexing, optimization, and performance tuning.
* Experience developing and troubleshooting data integrations, ETL/ELT processes, and SSIS packages.
* Hands-on experience creating, updating, monitoring, and troubleshooting Azure Data Factory and Synapse Pipelines.
* Experience with Databricks, Starburst, Azure Data Lake Service, and distributed or large-scale datasets.
* Experience with Collibra for data cataloging, metadata management, or data governance.
* Experience supporting Azure ML/AI services and preparing reliable data for analytics or machine-learning use cases.
* Experience supporting Pyramid Analytics and Power BI visualization solutions and validating source data.
* Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* Ability to communicate technical details to non-technical users and stakeholders, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability/Fitness determination based on client requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting federal agencies, the Department of Veterans Affairs, or other regulated environments.
* Experience with enterprise data lakes, lakehouses, Delta Lake, Parquet, and multi-cloud data integration.
* Experience working independently and collaboratively within Agile data-product teams.
